'''Force Playmat''' is the paper playmat insert packed with ''[[InQuest]]'' #38 (June 1998).<ref name="enc183" /> The uncut sheet is two playmats. The Dark Side mat is Darth Vader's Meditation Chamber, printed inverted on the top half. The Light Side mat is Yoda's Hut on the bottom half.

[[File:InQuest 38 Force Playmat encyc.png|thumb|right|260px|InQuest #38 Force Playmat insert.]]

<blockquote>
'''STAR WARS CUSTOMIZABLE CARD GAME'''<br />
'''FORCE PLAYMAT'''

'''Light Side''' (Yoda's Hut)

* Lost Pile
* Reserve Deck
* Force Pile
* Used Pile
* LIFE FORCE
* Draw
* Activate
* Use
* Re-circulate

'''Dark Side''' (Darth Vader's Meditation Chamber)

* Lost Pile
* Reserve Deck
* Force Pile
* Used Pile
* LIFE FORCE
* Draw
* Activate
* Use
* Re-circulate
</blockquote>

The sheet cuts in half into one mat for each side.<ref name="enc183" />
